item.text: Search currently checks only index text, so stale entries can affect both results and totals. Indexing also skips parent visibility checks, and the rebuild stops after the first page. I’m adding visibility checks at query and indexing time, plus archive cleanup and a paginated restore/rebuild path.

item.text: The changes now remove descendant entries on archive, check live parents before indexing, and reindex retained content on project restore. Rebuilds clear only the target workspace and walk every page. I’m checking these paths, including edits made while a project is archived and stale entries that must stay out of totals.
